verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents service keys built for AI agents, MCP servers, and scripts. These keys are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped to specific tasks, with a choice between full access and a limited set of specific scopes (docs-42). An alternative OAuth MCP flow binds an assistant to the user's own role permissions and attributes every action to that account. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of available scopes, key expiry/rotation/revocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
